translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: YONE
book.title: Yone Yonehanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Yasu mininigo ogo
Yasuhanda Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi ogoni lai howa ibunaga talima piagaru heba tagira pialu iba Kidirono doma ede halu puwa mabu mbira winigoria ubanda hene.
Mabu ogoriani Yasu ibunaga talima piagaru heba halu dewa ngoai haabo haga henego Yudasa ndelaga biago ibu manda bu hene.

Ani manda buwa Yudasa ibu Anduane Homogonaga anda mamage haga marubi Lomo ami agali marubi ti Perisi agalirubi loma binigo mo miaga haguane biarume pudaba laya handala ti haru lamu halebi agali bagane alebi yalu mabu biagoria haru pene.
Ibiyagola Yasu tigua ibuhondo bulebirago bibahende manda biai howa tihondo lalu, Tí ái hai bima eberamibe, lene.
Tigua ibuhondo ladai bialu lalu, Nasareteali Yasu hai berama, lene. Yasuhanda tihondo lalu, I̱ o kogoni, lene. Ndelagane Yudasa ibu ti mandagi hearia lamini.
Yasuhanda tihondo, I̱ o kogoni, layago hale howa ti bibahende tiga bebege dai bialu hearia dindini pindipandulo pilo ibira hai hene.
Yasuhanda tihondo halu mende lalu, Tí ái hai bima eberamibe, lene. Ani layagola tigua lalu, Nasareteali Yasu hai berama, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda tihondo ladai bialu lalu, I̱ o kogoni lalu abale langirugoni. Tígua i̱ hai beramiyagua agali o karu purogo lelo pudaba ladaba, lene.
Ibugua ala, Aba-o agali í̠na i̱ ngiriru mbirali pu ereba naholebira, lalu layadagua lola helo ani lene.
Saimono Pida ibu wai biagane ayu tibu yu henego ogoni yamuwa loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuninaga garabaya biabe ale bia haga mbira mini Malagasa heagonaga hale tiga bo bagada pe hene.
Ani biyagola Yasuhanda Pidahondo lalu, Í̠naga wai biagane ayu tibu andaneha da dai bia. I̱ Abahanda i̱hondo ibabe nginigo ogoniha tandaga nolene bedago nolebero ndobe, lene.
Yasu Anasa hearia haru penego ogo
Ani layago hale howa Lomo ami agali biaru tinaga haru haga heba Yuali mamage haga biarubi tigua Yasu minuwa gi huba bialu
mali ogoninaga loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuni Kaiabasa henego ibunaga imane Anasa hearia ala Yasu haru pene.
Kaiabasa ogoni ala ibugua Yu wali agalinaga haru hagahondo lalu, Wali agali bibahende homoligo mbiralime homa holene nga, lalu lene.
Pidahanda, Yasu manda nabido, lenego ogo

Tigua Yasu minu yalu piyadagua Saimono Pidabi Yasunaga talima piaga mendebi libu haru mama haruru pene. Talima piaga mende biago ibu loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbunime mandabi henego ti Yasu minu yalu piyadagua pialu ibu loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuninaga andaga anda pene.
Pida ibu pabe tagirahayagi hene. Talima piaga mende loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbunime mandabi biago ibugua dai buwa panga mamage haga wandari heagohondo bi lamuwa Pida haru anda ibini.
Haru ibiyago hondowa panga haru hagane wandari biagome Pidahondo lalu, Agali o haru poragonaga talima piaga mbira í̠ ndobe, lene. Ani layagola Pidahanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱ ndo, lene.
Dagare biyagola biabe bia hagane agalibi mamage haga agalibi tigua ira delowa dagare dogo bialu hearia hondowa Pida ibu puwa ti heba mandagi howa dagare dogo bialu hene.
Loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuni biagome Yasuhondo bi hale henego ogo
Loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuni biagome Yasuhondo hale halu lalu, Í̠naga talima ibaga agali ai kabe. Í̠na mana agi lalu lawai harilibe, lene.

Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Wali agali karu bibahende ti hale hai helo panigiore howa lamialu haruli. Yu wali agali ngoai hagane andaha howabi Anduane Homogonaga andaha howabi i̱na mana lawai haruli. Mbira do howa nalaruli.
I̱hondo aginaga hale harebe. I̱na mana lamirugo hale hene karu ti manda biai kago tihondo hale habe, lene.
Ani layagola mamage haga agali mbira heagome hale howa ibunaga gi habeme Yasu bowa lalu, Loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbunihondo ogonidagua ladai birilibe, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Kagua ago larugonaga baribe. Kagua mbira laruyagua ogo larigonaga baru lalu o karu hale helo lamia, lene.
Ani bialu Anasahanda, Loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuni Kaiabasa karia haru pudaba, layagola Yasu gi huba biaabo heaore haru pene.
Pidahanda lone lalu, Yasu manda nabido, lenego ogo
Pida ibu ira deagoria dagare dogo bu hearia tigua ibuhondo lalu, Agali o haru poragonaga talima piaga mbira í̠ kegoni ndobe, lene. Ani layagola ibugua lalu, I̱ ndo, lene.

Pidahanda agali hale bagadape hayagonaga damene mbira loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuni biagonaga garabaya biabe ale bia haga dege heagome Pidahondo lalu, Mabuni ibu heba heria handarugo í̠ ndoyagoda, lene.
Ani layagola Pidahanda lone lalu, I̱ ndoore, lene. Ogoni lope heagolaore ega gogologome bi lene.
Pailate hearia Yasu haru penego ogo

Ani bialu tigua Yasu Kaiabasanaga andaga howa gabumanenaga haru haga andaga haru pene. Egerebagiore haru penego Yu agali ti áyu Bolangua Halu Penegonaga Horo nga manda buwa Anduane Homogonaga deni dodo nahe helo mana pugule ndoyagola ti anda biagoha anda nape tagirani hene.
Tagirani hearia Pailate ibu tagira puwa tihondo lalu, Agali ogonime agi biyagola godi lole haru ibirimibe, lene.
Ani layagola tigua ladai bialu lalu, Ibugua ko mbira nabidale iname naharu ibidamale, lene.

Pailatehanda tihondo lalu, Tínaga mana lo ngadagua godi lole ibu haru dai bidaba, lene. Ani layagola Yu agali biarume ibuhondo lalu, Inane hangume godi lowa agali mbira bo waholene nawi lo ngago, lene.
Tigua bi ogoni bame ndo lene. Yasuhanda bi ala lalu, Ogodagua biragola homolebero, lenego henemane lola helonaga lene.
Pailate ibu gabumanenaga andaga dai buwa Yasu olowa lalu, Yu wali agalinaga Handame Haga Kini í̠ kebe, lene.
Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Í̠ni manda buwa laribe be marume i̱ ogoni ka layago hale howa laribe, lene.
Pailatehanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱ Yu agali kobe. Í̠ ariarumebi í̠naga loma binigo mo miaga haguane hearumebi i̱na godi loliya í̠ haru ibiyago í̠na agi birigola haru ibiyabe, lene.

Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱ handame ho kogo dindi ogoali ndome handame ho ko. Dindi ogoalime handame ho kole Yu haru haga agalime i̱ bolilono i̱naga haruru ibaganerume wai bidale. I̱ handame ho kogo dindi ogoali ndome handame ho ko, lene.

Pailatehanda ibuhondo lalu, Aniyagua í̠ handame haga kini mbira kebe, lene. Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Í̠na handame haga kini kebe larigoniore ko. Henene lolene lamiai hole i̱ dindi ogoria dalirugola taba henenego ko. Wali agali henene lolene aria karu bibahendeme i̱naga bi hale hai haga ka, lene.

Ani layagola Pailatehanda ibuhondo lalu, Henene lolene agilebe, lene. Yasu homelo ba, lenego ogo (Madiu 27.15-31, Maga 15.6-20, Lugu 23.13-25) Ani lalu Pailate ibu Yu wali agali hearia tagira puwa tihondo lalu, Ibugua ko bini mbira nawidago
tínaga manani Bolangua Halu Penegonaga Horo harangi garabaya agali mbira golope holiya langeramiligo áyu Yu wali agalinaga handame haga kini golope holiya manda bidamibe, lene.
Ani layagola tigua hongo howa ladai bialu lalu, Agali ogoni ndo. Barabasa ibu golope habe, lene. Barabasa ibu page bia agali ba biagane hene.
